explication: Smear cursor is a Neovim plugin that animates cursor movement as a text-rendered trail. The user enables/configures it, after which cursor movement is animated and drawn in the terminal; README options also cover buffer/window transitions, insert mode, color, and particles. The source excerpts do not include the runtime Lua modules, so internal call relationships are left unverified rather than inferred from filenames.
